At closing, a simple notice for returning guests
It concerns the desk
Travelers: please review the following guidance if you are returning after a disruption with a companion animal shipment.

We ask you to speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as you arrive so that the record can be checked and support can begin without delay. If a crate is missing, our staff will help you prepare the report and confirm the next steps. <<FACT F118>> Our service is built on calm handling, careful review, and respect for the animal's welfare throughout the journey.

If a claim is approved, compensation is handled according to the standard process for the case. <<FACT F112>> You may be asked to provide travel details and any available receipts or release notes so that the file is complete. We will keep the discussion practical and clear, and we will answer concerns with care.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance and further guidance.
